Real Clifford grades for so(64,64) and grade-dependent i factors for u(64,64). Footnote 3 asks for a check of the decomposition.
Family template permits fibre commutators and i times anticommutators.
Invariant tensor space and incomplete preferred operator selection. No normalized coefficient list for Phi1 or Phi2.
Two-term operator template, factor -1/2, and Weyl-annihilation claim. The bracket branches and the exact algebraic curvature subspace are not selected.
Hodge star, contraction, ordinary commutator, and i times anticommutator.
